# getrequest

getrequest is Scalability as a Service for your API. Setup in minutes.
Scale to millions.

Put getrequest in front of your API and skip building the infrastructure:
queuing, automatic retries, and a full request log, ready for millions of
requests. Callers change one base URL; there is nothing to host and no code
to add to your backend.

## Product

- Category: API infrastructure, developer tools
- Positioning: Scalability as a Service
- Tagline: Setup in minutes. Scale to millions.
- Promise: Handle every request. Replay every failure.

## How it works: Relay, Retain, Recover

- Relay — each endpoint gets one URL (https://e.getrequest.io/{id}) and
  answers in one of three ways:
  - Sync API: forwards to your destination and returns its exact status,
    headers, and body. If your backend is down, the caller gets a real 502
    or 504.
  - Async API: answers 202 immediately, then delivers to your destination
    in the background with automatic retries (6 attempts over about 36
    minutes: 15s, 60s, 5m, 15m, 15m).
  - Static API: returns a JSON body you define (mock endpoints).
- Retain — every request is logged with headers, body, response, status, and
  timing, searchable for 7 to 30 days depending on plan.
- Recover — replay any logged request with its original headers and body,
  or bulk retry a selected or filtered set (Pro and Gro).

## Key capabilities

- Endpoints live in under 2 minutes from signup
- Live request inspector with search and filters
- Request replay and bulk retry (Pro, Gro)
- Shareable debug links, valid for 30 days, viewable without an account (Pro,
  Gro)
- Built-in authentication: Bearer, API key, Basic, HMAC, on both the
  endpoint and the destination
- Usage metering with pre-limit alerts

## Pricing

- Free: $0/mo — 10,000 requests/month, 7-day log retention
- Dev: $29/mo — 100,000 requests/month, 30-day log retention
- Pro: $99/mo — 1,000,000 requests/month, 30-day retention, replay, bulk
  retry, share links
- Gro: $399/mo — 5,000,000 requests/month, 30-day retention, everything in
  Pro at high volume
